admin.title: Meta / WhatsApp
admin.subtitle: The platform's Meta app: official WhatsApp signup (Embedded Signup, including coexistence with the WhatsApp Business app), Messenger/Instagram login and the shared webhook.
admin.secretHelp: Stored encrypted and never shown. Verifies webhook signatures.
admin.esConfigHelp: Facebook Login for Business → Configurations → “Embedded Signup” variation.
admin.coexConfigHelp: Only if you use a separate configuration for WhatsApp Business app numbers. Empty = the one above.
admin.loginConfigHelp: Facebook Login for Business configuration to connect pages and Instagram. Empty = standard scope list.
admin.verifyTokenHelp: Paste it in Meta → WhatsApp → Configuration → Webhook together with the URL.
admin.removeSecret: Remove App Secret from the panel
admin.removeSecretConfirm: Remove the App Secret from the panel? META_APP_SECRET will be used if set; otherwise webhooks will be rejected.
admin.setup1: Register your app as a Tech Provider (or Solution Partner) and complete business verification.
admin.setup2: Request advanced access (App Review) for whatsapp_business_management, whatsapp_business_messaging and business_management.
admin.setup3: Create a Facebook Login for Business configuration with the “Embedded Signup” variation and the WhatsApp product; paste its ID here.
admin.setup4: In WhatsApp → Configuration, set the webhook URL and token and subscribe the listed fields (smb_message_echoes, history and smb_app_state_sync are needed for coexistence).
admin.setup5: Add your domain under Facebook Login for Business → Allowed domains for the JavaScript SDK.
admin.setup6: Save the App ID and App Secret (App settings → Basic).

signup.question: Which number will you connect?
signup.coexTitle: I already use WhatsApp Business on my phone (coexistence)
signup.coexBody: Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app and is also connected here. You can bring your contacts and chat history.
signup.newBody: A number that isn't on WhatsApp (or that you'll stop using in the app). It will only live on the official API.
signup.coexReq: You need WhatsApp Business app 2.24.17 or later and your phone at hand: Meta will ask you to scan a code from the app. Keep the app open for a few minutes after connecting.
signup.coexLimits: Meta limitations: groups, disappearing and view-once messages aren't synced; broadcast lists become read-only; companion devices are unlinked; throughput is capped at 20 messages per second.
signup.pinHelp: 6 digits. If the number already has one, type it; otherwise we'll generate one and store it encrypted.
signup.inPopup: Finish the steps in the Facebook window…
signup.noSession: We didn't receive the WhatsApp account from Facebook. Please try again.
signup.sdkError: The Facebook SDK couldn't load (content blocker?). Disable it or use the manual setup.
signup.notAvailable: Connecting with Facebook isn't enabled on this platform yet. You can connect your number manually.
signup.doneCoex1: Your number keeps working in the WhatsApp Business app; whatever you answer from the phone shows up here as “Sent from the phone”.
signup.doneCoex2: We asked Meta for your contacts and chat history (if you agreed to share it). They arrive within minutes; keep the app open.
signup.doneCoex3: When you reply from the phone, the AI agent pauses in that conversation so it doesn't talk over you.
signup.doneStandard: Your number is registered on the official WhatsApp API and ready to receive messages.
signup.historyFailed: Chat history couldn't be requested; new messages will still sync.
signup.payment: To send templates, add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager (business.facebook.com/wa/manage).

manual.appSecretHelp: Not needed if you connect with Facebook; only if you use your own Meta app. We use it to verify your app's webhooks; it's stored encrypted.
